coverage.scope: Full unfused registered model; eval, batch=1, FP32, no TF32, no task postprocessing/NMS.
coverage.thop: 2 * existing THOP counters (legacy convention, including THOP normalization approximations).
coverage.einsum: 2 * product(unique index dimensions) for real FP32 binary dense contractions, MAC=2.
coverage.scan: 6*B*D*L*N factored variable-B/C recurrence; +2BDL for skip D*u; +BDL for delta bias; +BDL for softplus addition.
coverage.cross_merge: 3*B*D*H*W additions for four-direction merging; CrossScan movement has no arithmetic charge.
not_included: Scan exponentials and softplus special functions; symbolic counts are separate.
Other functional arithmetic, activations, statistics, interpolation and dense-head decoding not counted by THOP.
DS-SSM external softplus, energy/gamma/write/z gates and D*x residual; PFIM functional pooling/statistics/gates.
CUDA prefix-scan overhead, memory/address operations, preprocessing, NMS and postprocessing.
coverage.interpretation: Covered-operation estimate, not total FLOPs or hardware work; not directly interchangeable with THOP-only reports.
coverage.parameter_sharing: Registered shared parameters counted once; repeated module forwards counted per actual execution.
